other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Brahmin community
Applicant must reside in Andhra Pradesh
Applicant must hold a white ration card
Applicant must not have availed any amount under any other Government scheme for the same purpose
Orphan children must be below 14 years of age as of 31 Jan 2019
Elderly applicants must be above 60 years of age as of 31 Jan 2019
Widows and destitute women must be separated from their husband and lack legal documents
Differently‑abled persons of any age are eligible
benefits_summary: Provides monthly financial assistance ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹4,000 for eligible orphan children, differently‑abled persons, widows, destitute women, and elderly Brahmins.
